# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.7.0

**Nearby players: your rivals, live in every mode.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

On the Xbox, Geometry Wars 2 put your friends' scores everywhere: beside each mode, on the leaderboards, and in the corner while you play. On PC those spaces sat empty. Now they're filled with the PC Plus players whose scores are closest to yours.

- **Every mode on the Single Player screen** lists the players just above and just below you (three above, two below), with your own row lit up. A mode you haven't played yet shows the lowest scores on its board, so your first game will probably put you past someone.
- **Your next rival, while you play.** The corner of the screen shows the next score to beat, and the moment you pass it, it moves up to the next player.
- **The Leaderboards screen's Nearby filter** (it was Friends) shows them ranked.
- They're remembered between starts, so they show straight away, and updated in the background after each run.

It all comes from the online leaderboards, so it needs **Online leaderboards** on and a player name chosen on the launcher's **Gameplay** page (the launcher asks once). Your name can likewise appear on other players' screens as someone near their score. There are no notifications and no "you were overtaken" messages: the ladder simply looks different the next time you check it.

Also since v0.6.11: **PC PLUS+ on the title screen**, online leaderboards on by default (nothing is sent until you choose a name), and the one-time player name question in the launcher (v0.6.12).

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.7.0-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
